newsitem.title: USA: BAESA to defer principal payments.
newsitem.headline: BAESA to defer principal payments.

text.p: Buenos Aires Embotelladora SA (BAESA) said Friday it is in a standstill agreement with its major creditors, allowing it to defer principal payments on about $520 million of its total unsecured debt of about $682 million.
The company said the agreement gives it time and financial flexibility to come up with a long-term restructuring plan and gear up for the peak selling season in the Southern Hemisphere.
BAESA said that PepsiCo Inc has committed to give the company $40 million in financial and marketplace support.
The standstill agreement extends through March 31, 1997, providing for the payment of past due interest as well as provisions for future interest payments.
The company said it plans to report its fourth quarter and year-end results in early December.
